title: fix(metadata-protocol): the artifact envelope is stamped only on the bundle member the package ships (#23074)
body:
Fixes #23074
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

An `email_template` is identified by `(name, locale)`, so its locales form a bundle. When the environment saves an overlay of a member the package does **not** ship (a `zh-CN` version of a template the package ships in `en-US` only), that overlay is the environment's own item. `mergeArtifactProtection` grafted the bundle's artifact envelope onto it anyway: every caller looked the artifact up by name, canonical-first, so the `zh-CN` overlay was registered and served wearing the `en-US` artifact's `_packageId`, `_packageVersion` and `_provenance: 'package'`, and `isCodeArtifactBody` read it as packaged code.

PR #23070 (stage 2 of #22877, `038d4c9588`) routed around one reader: it lifted the member's runtime shadow on ANY member's artifact in `removeRuntimeShadow`. This PR changes the graft itself.

## Measured on `origin/main` `62ce45d140` (before) and on this branch (after)

The fixture is the stage 1/2 harness `packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts`: a real `ObjectQL` engine, the real protocol, and a versioned package that ships `acme.digest` in `en-US` only. Each reading comes after `en-US` and `zh-CN` overlays are saved and the kernel restarts, so both overlays are hydrated. `isCodeArtifactBody` appears as "code".

| reader of the unshipped `zh-CN` overlay | before | after |
|:---|:---|:---|
| registry entry (`getItem(type, name, undefined, 'zh-CN')`) | `_packageId: com.acme.mail`, `_packageVersion: 1.0.0`, `_provenance: package`; code **true** | `_provenance: org`, no package stamps; code false |
| registry artifact lookup (`getArtifactItem(..., 'zh-CN')`) | answers **the overlay itself** as the package's `zh-CN` artifact | `undefined` |
| by-name read, `GET ?member=zh-CN`: body and envelope | body wears the envelope; `provenance: package`, `packageId`, `packageVersion: 1.0.0` | no envelope; `provenance` / `packageId` / `packageVersion` absent |
| by-name read: `lock` / `editable` / `deletable` | `none` / true / true | `none` / true / true (unchanged, see below) |
| list, served and for execution | the `zh-CN` item wears the envelope | no envelope |
| overlay-entry retirement (`removeOverlayEntry(..., 'zh-CN')`) | **refused** as code | retires it |
| shadow heal (`removeRuntimeShadow(..., 'zh-CN')`) | lifts it (the #23070 name-level test) | declines: no `zh-CN` artifact (member level, below) |
| `DELETE ?member=zh-CN`, end state | entry gone, receipt `reset: true` | same |

CONTROL, measured at the same readers: the overlay of a shipped member (`acme.welcome` in `zh-CN`, and the canonical `en-US`) wears its artifact's envelope, is answered by its artifact, is served under its package, is refused by the retirement and un-shadowed by the heal. Nothing about it changes.

The other `isCodeArtifactBody` readers never see an `email_template` member, because each is gated on its own type: `runtime/src/domains/actions.ts` (actions), `runtime/src/flow-clone.ts`, `service-automation`'s flow precedence and the protocol's flow write refusal (flows), `plugin-security/src/packaged-permission-set-lock.ts` (permission sets), the protocol's declined-row predicates (shipped flows, code datasources, sealed types; `email_template` is overlay-enabled, so never sealed), and the registry's object branch and collision warning (objects, and composite artifacts only).

## The change

- **`mergeArtifactProtection` (`metadata-protocol`)** takes the type and grafts an artifact only onto a body of the **same bundle member**, read by `itemDiscriminator` (`bundleMemberOf`), the identity's one declaration in `ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`. An artifact of another member counts as no artifact. Every type without members reads `undefined` on both sides, so its merge is byte-for-byte what it was.
- **Its four call sites** pass the type, and the three that can serve a bundle member look the artifact up at the body's own member (`lookupArtifactItem`'s `member`): the boot and write-through hydration (`hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry`), the by-name read (`getMetaItem`) and the list (`readFlattenedMetaItems`). Without this second half, a shipped non-canonical member would lose its envelope, because the canonical-first lookup answers the `en-US` artifact for a `zh-CN` body (ablation A2 below). The view expansion (`expandRuntimeViewContainer`) only passes the type: a view has no members.
- **`removeRuntimeShadow` (`objectql`) returns to member level** for a named member: a shadow is lifted only where an artifact **of that member** takes its place. An unshipped member's overlay now declines there, and the heal's last tier (`removeOverlayEntry`) retires it, because it is no longer grafted. Naming no member keeps the group sweep, as before.
- No exported signature changes: `mergeArtifactProtection` and `bundleMemberOf` are module-private, and `removeRuntimeShadow` keeps its signature.

### Deliberately unchanged

- **The lock binds the name.** The read's `lock` and the `_lock` gate both come from the one item-lock resolution over every package that ships the NAME (`artifactLockLayerAt`). The merge applies the read's resolved lock before its member check, so a template the package locks stays locked in every locale, at the read and at the gate. Making the lock per member would loosen protection, and that is a contract decision this card does not carry.
- **`resettable` and the delete receipt** come from `isArtifactBacked(type, name)`, which is name-level and not the graft. An unshipped member still reads `resettable: true` and its reset answers `reset: true`. See the acceptance notes.

## Pins (real doors)

All in `packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts`, new block `[#23074]`, with each CONTROL as its own case:

- the boot hydration: the unshipped member registers as the tenant row it is (no stamps, not code, no `zh-CN` artifact); CONTROL: the shipped members' overlays wear their artifacts' envelopes;
- the by-name read `?member=zh-CN`: served as the environment's item (no envelope, `lock: none`, editable, deletable); CONTROL: the shipped member is served under its package;
- the list, served and for execution: the same split;
- the reset `?member=zh-CN`: the unshipped member is declined by the shadow heal and retired by the overlay-entry tier, at once and after a restart; CONTROL: the shipped member is un-shadowed onto its artifact and refused by the retirement;
- a registry that ignores `member` (answers the canonical artifact): the graft's own check keeps that artifact off the `zh-CN` body; the canonical member still wears it;
- CONTROL: a type with no members (`translation`, which carries a `locale` but is identified by its name) keeps its artifact's envelope when the overlay's `locale` differs from the artifact's.

Also updated: the `registry-i18n-bundle-key.test.ts` case that pinned the name-level lift for an unshipped member now pins the member-level decline and the retirement. The two call-site ledgers (`protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`, `protocol.register-item-call-sites.test.ts`) record the new argument text.

## Ablation

Run from committed state with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, under a `trap` restore. Each `metadata-protocol` leg was rebuilt and checked with `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`, because objectql's suite reads that package's `dist/`. The two legs that delete the guard fail the DTS step (TS6133: the new `type` parameter is unread), but ESM and CJS are emitted, and the preflight proves the ESM the suite consumes carries the mutation. Every restore was proven by blob hash equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`, then rebuilt and preflighted present again. The final run was 29/29 green.

| leg | mutation | red | green |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| A3 | the unconditional graft back: guard removed, canonical-first lookups | 6: all five unshipped cases, plus #22877's door case for a member no artifact ships | every CONTROL (23) |
| A1 | the guard alone removed | only "a registry that answers another member's artifact" | 28 |
| A2 | the member-addressed lookups alone removed | exactly the four shipped-member CONTROLs | 25 |
| A4 | `removeRuntimeShadow` back to the name-level test (registry source, no build) | only the unshipped reset case | 28 |

A3 also shows the decision about `removeRuntimeShadow`: with the graft back, the member-level heal leaves the grafted overlay registered (the #22877 door case turns red). So the member-level test is sound **because** of the graft fix, and not without it.

One leg is declared void: a first A3 run coincided with an unlocked `check:type-check-debt`, whose full build rewrote `metadata-protocol/dist/index.js` mid-leg. The preflight caught it (`marker still present`), and the run was redone with nothing in parallel (the readings above).

## Evidence

- Real door: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/email-template-two-locales-survive-boot.dogfood.test.ts`, the showcase file that found the defect (real SQLite, real `sendTemplate`, real MetadataService), passes 4/4 on the fixed `dist/`: `DELETE ?member=zh-CN`, then the next `zh-CN` send uses the admin's `en-US` wording at once, and `?member=zh-CN` is 404 after a cold boot.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` exit 0 (its `check:test-typecheck` held the ledger).
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `vitest run`: 228 files passed, 3 skipped; 28203 tests passed. `@objectstack/objectql` `--project local`: 408/408 files, 7984 tests; `--project repo`: 1/1 file, 5 tests. All at `5d156f7044`.
- Lint, a proven narrowing: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the six changed TS files (`eslint.config.mjs` applies to all six, and none is reported as ignored) gives 6 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. This repo's config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
- Gates: the derived union `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `5d156f7044` (the dispatch's 58 commands plus 11 changeset families this diff adds): **69 commands, 69 exit 0**, each exit code captured before any pipe. Reconciled with `--ran`: `69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` were measured after a full `turbo run build` of `./packages/*` (72 tasks) at that head. Every heavy run went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, and each result is its `VERDICT command-exit 0` line.

## Acceptance notes

- `resettable: true` on the by-name read, and `reset: true` on `DELETE ?member=`, for a member the package does not ship: both come from `isArtifactBacked(type, name)`, by name. After that reset the `zh-CN` sends fall back to the package's `en-US` wording (the send ladder), while `GET ?member=zh-CN` answers 404. So "reset to the package default" is true at send time and not at the by-name read. #22877 pinned `reset: true` for this case on purpose. Recorded, not changed here. Carrier: none.
- `getMetaItemLayered` takes no member, so its code layer is always the canonical artifact. That is unchanged and outside the graft.
